$comment: HAND-EDITED source of the General section's Agent Chat reply rows and Needs You (cx-d5b5d). scripts/cmux-next/gen-settings-sources.py writes the Swift descriptors and parser constants from it (its docstring is the row format); schemas/settings/settings-schema.json is still exported from Swift and must not change when rows move here.

lists.name: agentPane
lists.note: The agent chat's reply rows (decisions D4 and D5): what a path chip outside the session's folders does, and when a web image in a reply loads. Both decide what leaves the project or the machine, so an agent may not change them (SettingsSchema.agentRefusedKeys). Also Needs you in the chat header (AgentPaneNeedsYouSetting), an App Store item an agent may set.

rows.name: outsideRoots
rows.note: What a path chip outside the session's folders does: opens like one inside them (open), asks first (confirm) or draws as plain text (text). A path on the deny list (~/.ssh, keys, .env files) is always plain text.

help.text: What a file link in a reply does when the file is outside the chat's folders. Keys and .env files never open.

summary.text: File links outside the chat's folders

rows.name: remoteImages
rows.note: A web image in a reply loads after a click (click), never (never) or at once (always); every load goes through the host's fetch rules.

help.text: A web image loads from its site, which then sees that you read the reply.

summary.text: Sites can see that you read the reply

rows.name: enabled
rows.note: An App Store item, off until the person gets it from the App Store or Settings (Leo 2026-10-22: "app store maybe?").

help.text: A badge in the chat header counts what your agents wait on; a click lists every ask with its answers. New agent tabs.
